sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Norway spruce is a large European conifer of boreal and montane forests, reaching about 50–60 m.

sections.title: Needles and cones
sections.text: The quadrangular needles, 1–2.5 cm long, attach singly to small peg-like bases. The secondary branches hang down. The hanging female cones are about 10–18 cm long and fall whole when mature.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The wood is used for construction and paper. The catalogue entry “Picea” represents the same species, Picea abies.
